finding: The smooth ambient isotopy conclusions require neat (transverse-boundary) embeddings. The source uses proper without explicitly binding that term to transversality, while the actual local smooth-embedding definition does not include it. Under merely boundary-preimage/topological properness, (a),(c) are false. counterexample.verification: Its base radius R(r)=r(3−r²)/2 is strictly increasing on0≤r<1 with R(1)=1 and R′(1)=0. Hence it is injective and its interior is interior to the solid torus. At the center its base derivative is(3/2)I. For0<r<1 the base radial/angular derivatives have positive rank; at r=1 its radial derivative is a nonzero fiber vector while its angular derivative is a nonzero meridian vector, so it is a smooth immersion everywhere. Compactness makes it an embedding with standard meridian boundary. At every boundary point its tangent plane equals the ambient boundary tangent plane. A horizontal graph disk has a transverse inward tangent and meets that boundary plane in dimension1. A boundary-preserving ambient diffeomorphism preserves this intersection dimension, so no claimed ambient isotopy can carry the example to a horizontal graph disk or to an ordinary neat meridian disk with the same boundary.
